title: Skyline
description: A skyline (Contract 3): for each azimuth, the highest elevation angle at which terrain appears from the eye of the observer. Used for skylines/{id}.json and for the /api/skyline response. Entry k of both arrays belongs to azimuth k * az_step_deg and covers the wedge of azimuths within half a step either side of it.

version.description: Format version of this file. Increased on any format change.

lat.description: Latitude of the point actually used (after any rounding), degrees.

lon.description: Longitude of the point actually used (after any rounding), degrees, east positive.

elev_m.description: Ground height at the point, metres above the 1737.4 km sphere.

mast_m.description: Eye height above the ground, metres.

az_step_deg.description: Spacing between azimuths, degrees. 360 / az_step_deg is a whole number.

skyline_deg.description: 360 / az_step_deg elevation angles, degrees above the local level plane (negative = below). Entry k is the maximum over its whole wedge.

skyline_err_deg.description: 360 / az_step_deg uncertainty bounds, degrees. The true skyline at entry k lies within skyline_deg[k] +/- skyline_err_deg[k].

dem.description: Names of the elevation map(s) used. Show this with every result.

resolution_m.description: Pixel size of the finest elevation map used near the point, metres. Show this with every result.

max_reach_km.description: Farthest distance any azimuth had to search, km.
